name: Zhaojin International Gold Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhaojin International Gold Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the exploration, mining, smelting, and sales of gold products in China. It is also involved in mineral resources, ore mining and processing, and mineral product sales business, as well as develops and leases real estate properties. The company was formerly known as Zhongrun Resources Investment Corporation and change its name to Zhaojin International Gold Co., Ltd. in July 2025. Zhaojin International Gold Co., Ltd. was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Jinan, China.
